summary.zh: 生成海报与平面作品的 PNG、PDF 成品
summary.en: Produce posters and static artwork as PNG and PDF files.

description.zh: 先确立一套视觉主张，再据此绘制海报、艺术画等静态画面，输出 PNG 或 PDF。适合需要原创平面视觉的场合，只做新设计，不模仿现成作品。生成 PDF 需要可用的排版工具链。
description.en: Establishes a visual direction first, then renders posters and static artwork as PNG or PDF. Meant for original graphic work, with no reuse of existing artists' pieces. PDF output needs a working layout toolchain.
